The '''Albarrio sector''', also known as the '''Aris sector''', was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and bordered [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]] at [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]].

==History==
The sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vanko]].<ref name="RM" />

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''Pirates & Privateers'' established that Aris sector neighbored the Maelstrom. However, ''Riders of the Maelstrom'' had previously established that the planet [[Aris/Legends|Aris]] was located in Albarrio sector. It also mentioned the [[Aris Sector task force]]. As such, these are treated as alternate names for the same sector.
